title: The cocone $E\mapsto D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,E)$
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime and $X$ a scheme. The *constructible cocone* is the cocone of categories
([sk-def-sfb-filtered-two-colimit]) indexed by the set of finite extensions $E$ of
$\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$, ordered by inclusion, with

- categories $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,E)$ ([def-sfb-dcons-subfield]),
- transition functors $T_{E,F}$ for $E\le F$ ([def-sfb-constructible-extend-subfield]),
- vertex $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Qlb)$ ([def-sfb-dcons-qlbar]) and functors $T_{E,\Qlb}$
  ([def-sfb-constructible-extend-to-qlbar]),
- isomorphisms $T_{F,\Qlb}\circ T_{E,F}\cong T_{E,\Qlb}$
  ([def-sfb-constructible-extend-comp-iso]).

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NW-3ab326884 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole definition and every cited node. The statement matches the current blueprint main-20261015 def-sfb-constructible-cocone.md (order 1769) word for word, and stmt_deps is exactly the six ids the source lists under uses. Each of the six cited statements supplies exactly one piece of the cocone, with the right domain and codomain. sk-def-sfb-filtered-two-colimit gives the cocone data T_ij, Phi_i and theta_ij: Phi_j T_ij ≅ Phi_i, with no coherence required. dcons-subfield gives the stage categories, extend-subfield the transition functors T_{E,F}, dcons-qlbar the vertex and extend-to-qlbar the functors T_{E,Qlb}. comp-iso gives T_{F,Qlb} T_{E,F} ≅ T_{E,Qlb}, and with i=E, j=F this has the same direction as theta_ij. The coefficient categories are the bounded constructible derived categories of modules over the pulled-back condensed rings E_X and Qlb_X. They are not swapped for sheaves over discrete rings, and the item does not identify them with the separate condensed Omega variant used in the proper-base-change chapter. The item is not a target node and makes no base-change claim. The (Obj), (Hom-surj) and (Hom-inj) properties are not asserted; they stay with the lem-sfb-constructible-cocone-* nodes and thm-sfb-constructible-cocone-two-colimit. Edge cases checked: E=F (comp-iso is stated for E≤F, so equality is included), E=Q_l, a nontrivial E<F, X empty and X=Spec k; the definition needs no hypothesis on X. The proof fields are empty, which is correct for a definition. Tracing the dependencies (472 nodes reachable) never leads back to the item, so the in_cycle import flag is stale and was kept as the brief requires. A search for duplicates over the DAG found none: the only other 'cocone' definition, def-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-complex-diagram, is a cocone of cochain complexes for a different coefficient ring, so same_as [] is accepted. There are no new nodes, no SGA citations and no tool_uses. Mathlib searches of all three kinds (grep, loogle, leansearch, leanfinder) are recorded with their results.
